audience_problem: Trying to be useful or impressive can distract someone from listening to the person they hoped to help.

hook.text: At eleven fifty-eight, Mira deleted a message that took three hours to write

payoff.text: Before they hung up, Asha asked about Saturday. Same place for lunch? Mira found the little calendar on the fridge and circled the day. Same place, she said. Nothing needed to be ordered first. Nothing needed to be earned. They were simply making a plan.

packaging.title: She Deleted the Perfect Pitch. Here’s What She Sent Instead.
packaging.promise: Follow one evening from a carefully written product recommendation through a cupboard interruption and a missed request, to the exact eight-word message and an ordinary friendship ending.
